steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to the Directus Data Studio at http://127.0.0.1:8101/admin/ using email admin@example.com and password exactly {{env:APP_PASSWORD}}. Verify that the authenticated studio is open.
02-open: Open Tickets collection and report the exact titles of all items whose title starts with 'Seed:'; do not modify any ticket.

03-create: Create and save a ticket titled '{{runid}} Bench Ticket'. Its rich-text description must have exactly one paragraph containing the runid {{runid}}. Select the existing customer exactly named 'Bench Customer' (not similar customer names), set status to 'In progress', and set its only tag to 'hardware' (not hardware-return). Set due date to 2026-12-31 and estimated hours to 6. Save the item and verify all these saved values; report its displayed ticket ID and page address.

04-open: Complete the currently open unsaved ticket form for '{{runid}} Bench Ticket' and save it. Preserve its verified title, customer Bench Customer, status In progress, hardware-only tag and estimated hours 6. Enter a single rich-text paragraph containing {{runid}} and set due date to 2026-12-31. Find the proper save action in the Directus create-item form (do not treat the editor's Done as item save). Verify persisted fields after save and report page address/ID. If controls are hidden, use the visible app UI to reveal them and continue.
